draft_response:
Bonjour Chloe,

Thank you for contacting NovaTech Creative Solutions! We are delighted that you are using the NovaDraw vector asset pack.

To answer your question: Yes, NovaDraw v4.3 supports full Pantone® Formula Guide color swatch embedding directly within standard SVG and EPS export profiles, ensuring 100% fidelity when importing into Adobe Illustrator.

Please let us know if you need any additional sample palettes or documentation!

Warm regards,
NovaTech Product Specialists
